$comment: The source of every watchdog diagnostic text.
Generated from this file:
- WatchdogDiagnosticMessages in :kotlin-library-api-watchdog-compiler-plugin (build.gradle.kts).
The generator adds 'See more: <docsBaseUrl><docs>' after every message.
The compiler formats a message with parameters with java.text.MessageFormat, so the
generator escapes ' as ''.
- WatchdogChecks in :kotlin-library-api-watchdog-gradle-plugin (GradlePluginConventionPlugin):
one const val for each diagnostic name.
- The '// !diag[/range/] DIAGNOSTIC_NAME [params]' annotations in docs samples, which
docs/plugins/diagnostics.mjs validates and the docs Code component renders as tooltips.
Fields:
name: the diagnostic name. Matches the property in WatchdogDiagnostics.
title: the H1 of the check page. Shown in the docs tooltip.
docs: the check page path under docsBaseUrl, without an extension.
message: the message template. Consumers join adjacent lines with a space and keep an empty
line as a paragraph break. A line that starts with four spaces is a code line: consumers
keep the line breaks around it. Docs render it as Markdown.
parameterValues: named values for parameters that are wording, not a name from the code:
declaration kinds, fixes, hints. In the format of message. A value can have {0}, {1}, ...
placeholders. Checkers resolve a value through generated code. Docs annotations reference
it as $name or $name(value). A literal parameter in a docs annotation can't contain a
space or equal a listed value, so every wording parameter goes through this table.
sharedParameterValues: parameter values every diagnostic can use, in the format of
parameterValues. A diagnostic's own parameterValues win on a name clash.
Text rules:
- Enclose every code reference in backticks.
- Write ' as a single quote. The generator escapes it.
- Don't write the documentation link. The generator derives it from docs.
- Write a link as [text](url). The generator rewrites it to 'text (url)' for compiler output.
